name: Demario
reason: User rejected Mario-style mushrooms; original toolbox/work-boot choreography.
qaNote: Reference inspected. Verify no mushroom or franchise power-up iconography, tool and body continuity, pure cyan, costume-blue keying, title spelling and SFX. Not engine-approved.

params.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

DEMARIO — SPECIAL DELIVERY.
HARD CREATIVE RULE: zero mushrooms of any kind in any frame. No red spotted caps, mushroom-shaped objects, Mario power-ups, question blocks, warp pipes, collectible coins, star characters, Nintendo logos or recognizable game sound cues. The only action props are his original red steel toolbox, its ordinary metal tools, his work boots and fist insignias. Do not infer any props from other franchise characters.
IDENTITY: preserve the reference's muscular dark-skinned man, short black chin beard, red work cap with WHITE FIST emblem, white tank, royal-blue overall bib, red work trousers, tan heavy work boots and red toolbox at his hip. Preserve exact costume colors, proportions and existing fist emblems. Keep the toolbox a recognizable industrial rectangular red metal case with black handle and silver latches, no face.
0.0–0.7s: whole-character low-angle establishment on pure cyan. He hefts the toolbox by its handle, gives the viewer an intimidating side-eye, then swings it upward with a monstrous shoulder windup.
0.7–2.5s: he hurls the toolbox thirty feet into the distance. Camera rockets backward to show its rapidly receding arc, then whips alongside him as he launches after it in an explosive flying side kick. His heavy tan boot strikes the rear of the SAME toolbox like a cannon firing a steel projectile. One huge orange-gold, black-edged impact star erupts around boot contact; the toolbox hurtles toward the lens and becomes enormous through forced perspective, silver tools briefly rattling inside the cracked lid. Cyan remains visible around the case silhouette, never fill the entire screen with a prop or effect. Give the kick a sharp readable contact hold and immense bass slam, then brutal acceleration.
2.5–3.5s: smash-cut back to a clear full-body hero composition. The normal-sized toolbox drops from above; he catches its handle in one hand without looking as his boots settle into a powerful stance in the cyan void. Exact title SPECIAL DELIVERY slams below his face with warm white-to-gold thick comic lettering, black outline, dark extrusion and impact overshoot.
3.5–5.0s: one wrench springs out of the partly open lid with a tiny metallic twang. Still deadpan, he flicks it back inside with the toe of his work boot and clicks the lid shut. Hold the complete character, toolbox and readable title with cyan margin. His body and limbs remain intact; one toolbox, one wrench, no duplicates.
SOUND: metallic toolbox rattle, deep shoulder-windup creak, accelerating rocket-like air rush, enormous boot-to-metal cannon impact, heavy catch thunk, tiny wrench twang, neat closing click. Original physical comic SFX, no music, speech or familiar platform-game jingles.
